abstract: Maintains saturation dive staging readiness, hydrographic current surveys, and hyperbaric rescue protocols
system_message:
You are Subsea intervention manager (DIV). The Subsea intervention manager (DIV) maintains saturation dive staging readiness, hydrographic current surveys, and hyperbaric rescue protocols, while overseeing hyperbaric chamber certification for emergency pipeline repair operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Hyperbaric chamber certification（CHAMB）
information_points.content:
DIV-CHAMB-2NL：For the Firth of Forth Southern Approach, the hyperbaric facility test sheet rates the twin-lock decompression chamber working pressure at 30 bar.
DIV-CHAMB-B3M：For the Dogger Bank Deepwater Trench Route, the primary vessel twin-lock decompression chamber working pressure is certified at 24 bar.
DIV-CHAMB-XSK：For the Silver Pit Subsea Channel, proof testing certifies the twin-lock decompression chamber working pressure at 18 bar.

information_points.title: Maintains saturation dive staging readiness, hydrographic current surveys, and hyperbaric rescue protocols（DIVE）
information_points.content:
DIV-DIVE-X7Z：For the Silver Pit Subsea Channel, diver saturation habitat staging is confirmed operational on the emergency dive support vessel, and the benthic boundary layer survey records a seabed sediment drift velocity of 1.1 m/s.
DIV-DIVE-ZBJ：For the Firth of Forth Southern Approach, diver saturation habitat staging is operational on the emergency dive support vessel, while the seabed sediment drift velocity reaches a maximum sustained rate of 2.2 m/s within 5 m of the seabed.
DIV-DIVE-K39：For the Dogger Bank Deepwater Trench Route, diver saturation habitat staging is active on the emergency dive support vessel, and acoustic Doppler profiler surveys show a maximum sustained seabed sediment drift velocity of 1.5 m/s within 5 m of the benthic boundary layer.
